newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Northern sets I-5 service for July.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Northern sets I-5 service for July.

text.p: In a quarterly progress report filed with the Surface Transportation Board Tuesday, Burlington Northern Santa Fe Corp said it will offer daily merchandise train service in each direction on the I-5 corridor along the West Coast.
The company said it had been unable to agree on proportional rates on this corridor until May 22, but now expects to close on the purchase of the line July 15, when it begins the service.
The I-5 corridor track was orignially included in the September merger with the Union Pacific-Southern Pacific system.

The company also said in the filing that trackage rights volumes continue to grow in all corridors. The number of units handled in the second quarter of 1997 increased by almost 50 percent to just under 21,700 units, up from approximately 14,000 units in the first quarter.

Burlington Northern has also increased the frequency of service on its trackage rights on a number of lanes, to 169 local and through scheduled trains per week, up from the 105 at the end of the first quarter.
